title: The Bride
review: Jessie Buckley plays the bride and Christian Bale plays Frankenstein’s monster. It’s like a Bonnie and Clyde story with female empowerment themes. I didn’t like how Jesse Buckley played the character and thought it was overacted. It’s played very over the top where she seems to carry the injustices of her prior life but at the same time doesn’t make an attempt to resume it. Her random yelling and erratic behaviour causes the pair to get into fights and get caught by police. Maybe it’s lazy writing, it just feels frustrating how dumb they are. I liked Jake Gyllenhaal’s character  playing a Fred Astaire type and would’ve wanted to see more old Hollywood references.
